notes.title: SBDS Legacy Branch + developer Deep Lore
notes.content:
The new [b]Apocalypse[/b] update will be changing the game a very large amount, including pushing the timeline of the game forward in a way that would typically be considered a sequel.

Because of this, [b]all players[/b] who own or buy the game will also be able to play the current version of the game on the [b]Legacy Beta Branch[/b] when the Apocalypse update launches.

My other projects have gone through similar transformations:

[h1]Kingdom Hearts: Critical Mix[/h1]
[b]Kingdom Hearts: Critical Mix[/b] is a full overhaul mod of KH1 that completely revamps the combat system, abilities, equipment and weapon system, and more. At first the mod was just a Level 1 challenge mode rebalance that was still mostly identical to the regular game, but as new modding tech became available it changed into an entirely new experience that feels extremely different from the original game.

Later on, new modding tech again made it possible to port this mod from the PS2 version of the game onto the PC version of the game, and along with that came a fairly significant number of differences between the two versions of the mod where each version has things that the other one doesn't / can't. The PC version does sacrifice a bit of the depth of the PS2 version, but is way more accessible and tends to "just work" in a way that the other one doesn't.

I also developed separate randomizers for both versions of Critical Mix, as well as a Riku variant of the mod with some different combat mechanics.

(Also i made an animation cancelling mod for Birth By Sleep called "Better Battle System" that you might like if you wished BBS was fun)

[h1]Malice & Greed[/h1]
[b]Malice & Greed[/b] is my first game, a rougelike RPG featuring a combat system that combines Shin Megami Tensei's "Press Turn" system with a color-based resource generation system influenced by Magic: the Gathering. This game originally launched as a janky prototype with an open-layout map and extremely long runs similar to a game like Darkest Dungeon.

Over time the game structure changed completely into a much shorter Slay the Spire style run, and the reward structure went through an overhaul similar to the one that Spellbook Demonslayers is getting (more categorization and gamification).

I plan to completely remake Malice & Greed again in the future when i have a larger team and more experience + budget, into a ps2-style 3d roguelike RPG that I would have originally made if i had the ability. The current version of M&G will also become a Legacy branch, just like SBDS is.

[h1]but why[/h1]
I didn't specifically choose to work like this, but every time I get better at making stuff it makes me a lot more critical of my old work and usually makes it really clear where i went off-course from making the thing that I actually wanted to make. Often what happens is that you are learning to make things you've never made before, so you end up losing sight of the game design while focusing on getting things to work at all.

Rather than just launching a half baked "1.0" and then making people buy an entirely new game to get the full experience that I wanted to give originally, I'm going to just let people have both versions and they can choose which one they enjoy more (or play both of them).

[h1]but why the spicy version of the game[/h1]
Spellbook Demonslayers original version was heavily nerfed and self-censored. This might come across as a big tone shift for people who only know me from this game, but the tone and themes of the new SBDS is what you should expect from most of my stuff. The SFW version of the game and NSFW version of the game will always remain as entirely separate products on Steam, so you can always choose the SFW version without worry if you prefer.

notes.title: Info About Next Update
notes.content:
Haven't been available much to communicate becuase of family & housing stuff i've had to work on

first just to clear up some potential confusion:

- The Hades style prototype is for a sequel coming out after this game's 1.0. The prototype is extremely outdated though. Spellbook 1 will remain an auto-shooting game.

- The update that changed the knockback system and adds the 2nd character has actually been out for a few months, but I didn't draw attention to the launch of it. That update is not the "1.0" update.

[b]here are some of the things coming in the next update:[/b]

[list][*] Replaced Spellbook system, books now have unique "Signature Spells" that cost Mana. Regular spells still do not cost Mana, only Signature Spells.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/994a971d70a80a5b00c76bf9576c11ffb3d6c889.png[/img]
[*] Dual book upgrade can be found during runs allowing you to run 2 books & Signature Spells at the same time.
[*] New Auto-attacking dual-wielding weapon system. Attacks generate Mana, and can be Charged. You can swap between 2 equipped weapons instantly with a button press.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/2418dfd16993cde4a84356ea620bd4502af990f4.png[/img]
[*] New Weapon Fusion system to customize and extend their combos. All weapons can have their attacks replaced with those of any other weapon, letting you combine their unique abilities with any moveset you want. You can also slot [b]Instant Attacks[/b] in between your regular combo attacks. These often come with bonuses like applying status effects on hit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/dabf22773f437d21e8494f699b2acfe6a4b39937.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/d6d4c6041713c596ebeb9f6dfd9ad785c9dd87f5.png[/img]
[*] New "Augments" system: Lets you socket upgrades into your spells and abilities to add effects. Spells begin with no Augments, but each Ability comes with 1 starter Augment. As you equip new Augments in runs you will also unlock them to use as your starting augment as well, offering lots of horizontal progression.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/cb7f44d2bfa0e660157df605f0e73e87e9d9cc77.png[/img]
[*] New Level Up System: The character you aren't playing as brings you reward portals of various types. That character can also be customized each run with utility upgrades.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/7fa37a534b6fccd412472404755f660557fe4289.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/54720d3849da15e1a7ac15c193a03802b8fdb55e.png[/img]
[*] New Battle Modifiers System: After you level up you are given a choice between a few different portals to continue through. Some of them will add additional risk/reward effects onto combat, letting you scale the intensity to your liking.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/ee96bae1f1ab534ad4791c1a7aaf1b5924cd1c9f.png[/img]
[*] New Wall Slam system: Damages and staggers enemies when you bounce them off walls and objects with Knockback. (Stagger is also new)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/b5bf481f9c5a7d972f1adeff38931990ac23edf8.png[/img]
[*] New "Devour" system: Strong enemies are crystallized on death. Devour their corpse within 13 seconds to make the crystals explode. The crystals are also objects that can block or Wall Slam enemies. Devour is considered an Ability, so it can be socketed with Augments.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/8d57855cc096376321570cede51299bbda43934e.png[/img]
[*] New "Shapeshift" System: Hold the dash button to shapeshift into Astral Fox Jeanne, draining Mana to greatly reduce your hitbox size. Shapeshifting also happens while you are Dashing, but regular dashes no longer cost Mana. The Mana drain only begins if you continue Shapeshifting after the Dash ends. Shapeshifting is an Ability that can be socketed with Augments.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/f6aa5df0506397c98a8cada7785ba8fb861e4e5d.png[/img][/list]

Runs in this new system can be far more different than they can now, even without taking build archetypes into consideration. You can have runs focused entirely on weapons, on basic spells, on signature spells, focusing on any of your abilities, or mixing and matching any of them freely. Then within all of that, you also have archetypes like building into various status effects, elemental effects, and so on.

The previous version of the game is nothing compared to what this will be.

[b]plus a lot more. i'llalso be replacing some existing parts of the game that are bad.[/b]

The new update also has a lot of improvements to fundamentals like:

[list][*] New tooltip system that displays info about your stats, detailed info on attacks & spells, and also displays a box of all upgrades you have that share the same tooltip. You can press the "View Embedded Tooltips" button to dig into these tooltips and view the tooltips of the upgrades that are being displayed inside the original tooltip.
[*] New text system that shows before & after info about stat changes on upgrades.
[*] Good controller support (i now play mainly on controller)
[*] Fully rebindable controls
[*] Overhauled aiming. On controller, simply aim with the Right Stick to instantly take control with manual aim, then let go of the stick again to immediately switch back to autoaim. On keyboard and mouse, hold or toggle the "Aim With Mouse" button to seamlessly switch between automatic and manual aiming.
[*] New camera and lock-on systems
[*] Redesigned every UI in the game
[*] Improved fonts and colors
[*] Expanded options menu
[*] New Stats & Stat reworks (especially Energy Shield)
[*] A bunch of new music by artists like Novander, including existing songs like LOTUS and VICIOUS and new original tracks created for the game.[/list]

... and more!

notes.title: COMING SOON: New PLAYABLE CHAR, Game Feel FIXED, Drop Rates DOUBLED!
notes.content:
[h3][b]COMING SOON[/b]: This update will contain new content, but also a lot of significant changes to existing things because I felt like the feel of the game was [b][i]way[/i][/b] off from where it should be.[/h3]

[h1]New Character: Skye[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/c289243de6e6da2c7ca3ad46c956d2f10db94250.png[/img]
The Cosmic Library has given you authority over Skye's restraints, allowing you to control her on the battlefield. Skye has access to a new dash ability:

[h1]Demon Cleave[/h1]
Cut down enemies with the Demon Blade at the start and end of your dash. All mana is spent to enhance & repeat the effect against nearby enemies.

[h1]Knockback System Rewrite[/h1]
The knockback system has been [b]completely rewritten[/b] to be bouncier, more dynamic, and way less performance intensive. This has a bigger effect on the gameplay than you might expect.

[list][*] The old system caused runs to only ever be in a state of winning or dead, which made the game turn mostly into a math equation. Now you can properly use knockback & dashes to push through rough patches while you try to get an upgrade that swings the run back in your favor. Revives feel more useful because of this, and the game feels much more "gamey".
[*] When you take damage, the enemy that damaged you will be knocked back by a set distance.[/list]

[h1]Enemy Movement Changes[/h1]
[list][*] Enemies are now much less likely clump into overly-tight clusters.
[*] Enemies are now more capable of surrounding you. This is a good opportunity to use the new knockback system to push your way through.
[*] The player hitbox is now smaller, making it easier to weave through crowds.[/list]

[h1]Smuggler's Shrine Change[/h1]
[list][*] Smuggler's Shrines now either offer you 4 spells or 4 upgrades when completed, instead of 1 spell and 3 upgrades.
[*] Rerolls for Illegal Spells and Illegal Upgrades are now 2 separate buttons, making it much less expensive to find what you want.[/list]

[h1]Progression[/h1]
[list][*] Drop rates for demons and charms have been [b]doubled[/b].
[*] Increases to Max Corruption now accelerate at higher amounts.
[*] Most difficulty options have been condensed into 1-point toggles instead of multiple points. (You should review your difficulty settings if you are playing below max difficulty)
[*] "Bullet Hell" Malice modifier effect has been combined with "Escalation" as a single modifier.
[*] "Ritual" Oblivion modifier total exp penalty on Banish changed from -60% to -50%.
[*]"Ceremony" Oblivion modifier total exp penalty on Reroll changed from -60% to -30%.[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list][*] You now gain +2 Max Level for each point of Oblivion.
[*] [b]The EXP curve has been changed[/b]: Levelling requires more EXP between levels 20 - 60, but less EXP before level 10 and after level 60. At level 80+, all levelups require the same amount of EXP. Roughly the same total amount of EXP is required to hit 125 as before (but 175 is the new 125, so hitting that will take a bit longer).
[*] You now must kill all elites before overtime will begin. Normal enemies still spawn during this time so you can trigger on-death effects, but EXP gems will stop dropping from them until overtime begins.
[*] Enemy projectiles no longer become ridiculously fast in endless, but they have higher base speed.[*] Elite enemies no longer gain increasing amounts of armor.
[*] Corrupted Shrines no longer spawn in the first map.
[*] Adjusted the enemy waves of each map.

[*] Aura: Cybernetics has been changed to give -13% Max HP instead of +4% Max HP Reservation.
[*] Aura: Deathbound, Evolution: Passion and Warfare has had its Max Level bonus while Second Chance is unequipped increased from +3 to +13.
[*] Aura: Juggernaut now grants +20% Knockback and +7 Max HP insted of +13% Knockback and +13 HP.
[*] Arcane Aura: Cremation now also grants +13% Projectile Size.

[*] Illegal Upgrade: Dragon Chaser now also grants +30% Buff Effect in addition to summoning 7 shrines.
[*] Illegal Upgrade: Grim Row has been changed into an Arcane Aura.
[*] Illegal Upgrade: Overclock has been changed to an Arcane Upgrade. It now grants +7 Max Level, +2 Rerolls, and +1 Overlevel.
[*] Illegal Upgrade: The Best Defense now grantes +20% Damage Reduction instead of +13%.
[*] Illegal Upgrade: Brilliance has been changed to +77% Light Radius, -13% Exp Gain
[*] Illegal Upgrade: Upgrades that rely on stats that they don't offer themselves now only appear if you have the related stat.
[*] Illegal Upgrade: Nines now gives -99% HP instead of -999% HP.

[*] Upgrade: Defiance now reqiures the 7 Malice achievement to unlock.
[*] Upgrade: Second Chance now requires the 77 Malice achievement to unlock. Its cooldown is now 13 seconds instead of 7.[/list]

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
[list][*] "Brain Tease" and "Bulk Up" lesser upgrades can now appear if there are any empty slots in your upgrade list, instead of only when the list would be empty.
[*] The maximum number of elites on screen at once has been increased from 13 to 50.
[*] Spirit Shield has been renamed to Phantom Shield[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
Various bug and crash fixes. Some notable fixes include:
[list][*] Fixed autoaim bug causing each shot to have a chance of firing in a random direction.
[*] Fixed issue where demons would be equipped/unequipped when manually levelling them up.
[*] Fixed issue where regular enemies could get teleported offscreen at random.
[*] Fixed issue where offscreen enemy culling would sometimes fail to activate.
[*] Fixued issue where some enemies would fail to spawn from spawn notifications.
[*] Save data stability improved.[/list]

Once I get a good feel for the new state of the game with the builds that people are playing on this version, I will be adding more upgrades and spells to support as many playstyles as possible.

notes.title: NEW Features & BIG Balance Changes! [July 17]
notes.content:
[h1]NEW Features & BIG Balance Changes![/h1]

[h2]New Permanent Upgrades / Enemy Spawn Change[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/656103a203c45910ae5c4f9c9632e22227d50feb.png[/img]
[i]The Expel mechanic changes how you interact with demon spawns. Instead of taking a hit because a demon spawned too close to you, now you will be rewarded with bonus experience.[/i]

[b]Permanent Upgrade: Expulsion[/b]
This upgrade causes demons to be [b]Expelled[/b] when you touch their spawn notification, teleporting them away and dropping an Experience gem.
[list]
[*] Strong enemies now have larger and differently colored spawn notifications.
[*] You can now also purchase two points of +13% Demon Spawn Warning Duration in the upgrades menu.
[*] Astrid's Time Dilation passive now grants +50% Demon Spawn Warning Duration
[*] Spawn notifications now have a different animation instead of flashing.[/list]
You might want to turn off Damage Numbers if you are focusing on Expel a lot, to make it easier to see.

[h2]Ultimatum[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/90e695d8dbae426d072ac394b73e66b27c8290d6.png[/img]
You can now earn greater rewards using the [b]Ultimatum[/b] system. Increasing the Ultimatum amount at a Corrupted Shrine will Spawn another shrine with increased rewards and difficulty, but enemy damage is permanently multiplied by +7% and yours by -7%.

Each step in an Ultimatum is harder & longer than the previous, and new Corrupted Shrines that spawn during it will become a part of your current Ultimatum. The Ultimatum ends when you choose an Arcane Upgrade.

Ultimatums will reward you with Charms, Demons, Astral Flowers, and Upgrade Chests, as well as a large amount of recovery orbs. The rewards are weighted towards Charms and Demon Chests.

[h2]Illegal Spell Selection[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/4a719f484d5a2946d1ea57bb7b68b763aa0e2e40.png[/img]
You can now choose what spell you want to replace when taking an Illegal Spell at the Smuggler's Shrine.

[h2]Treasure Upgrade Auto-Confirm[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/faf3af2a22a5e4528f74314357724c33d7b872da.png[/img]
You can now enable an option that automatically skips treasure chest upgrade interfaces. A notification will be shown below your spells instead.

[h2]Rampage[/h2]
[b]Rampage[/b] is a new effect that grants +1.3% damage and +0.7% Movement Speed per stack (Max: 100). Drains rapidly if you haven't gained any Rampage recently.

The time it takes before Rampage begins draining is extended if you gain multiple stacks at once.

[h2]Changes & Fixes[/h2][list]
[*] De-Yandere'd a bunch of the stat calculation code.
[*] Damage values over 1 million on stat displays are now shortened like "584.23m".
[*] More spell info is now shown on the pause screen.
[*] The Demon Summoning screen has been reorganized.
[*] The description for spell ugprades above level 10 has been changed to "Base Damage +10%" instead of "Spell Damage Multiplier +10%". This is only a text change, the mechanic itself has not been changed.
[*] Breaking the spell limit with Overlevel now shows the over-limit spell on the HUD.
[*] The Overlevel button now displays the Overlevel tooltip.
[*] Fixed an issue where Vella would only be unlocked if the spell you had 4 copies of had one of its copies in the first spell slot.
[*] Fixed an issue where Time Splicer's damage bonus was only applying in increments of 100%.
[*] Fixed an issue where Elite demon armor scaling was not working properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where Goblin's demon equip bonuses were not being applied.
[*] Fixed an issue where spawn notifications could spawn very far offscreen.
[*] Fixed an issue where Sigma Stance's description said 33% instead of 30% (this is only a text change, the effect itself has not been changed).
[*] Fixed an issue where Corrupted Shrines would sometimes not display the required amount of kills.
[/list]

[h2]New In-Run Upgrades[/h2]
[h3]Illegal: Unencumbered Rage[/h3][list]
[*] The inverse of your [b]Armor[/b] is also applied to: Max Rampage.[/list]
[h3]Illegal: Mana Storm[/h3][list]
[*] Each Rampage stack also grants: Mana Recharge Speed +0.7%.[/list]

[h2]Aura & Effect Changes[/h2]
[h3]Mending[/h3][list]
[*] Now has "+1.3% HP Regenerated per second" instead of "Regeneration +1.0".[/list]
[h3]Bloodletting[/h3][list]
[*] Now has "+1.3% HP Regenerated per second" instead of "Regeneration +1.0".[/list]
[h3]Samsara[/h3][list]
[*] Now has Max HP +13% instead of Max HP -13%.
[*] Mutation: Life In Death now also has "For each used and remaining Revive: Max HP +13."[/list]
[h3]Nightshade[/h3][list]
[*] Now has "Critical Multiplier +25%" instead of "Critical Chance +7%".
[*] Unbinding cap increased from 7 to 9. [/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/2d4e74bf6562174190fe1f9f357cffce9bd971fa.png[/img]

[list][*] Illegal spells now gain 1 bonus level when learned. NOTE: Remember that you always keep Global Bonuses. When Illegal spells are auto-levelled on learning them, it includes their level 6 Global Bonuses. notes.title: The OBLIVION Update is HERE! [New Features]
notes.content:
[b]Today's update brings a HUGE amount of new features and improvements - There's a lot to cover with this one, so let's just jump right into it![/b]

[h2][b]New Spellbook - Vella[/b][/h2]

[i]"I'll eat you alive!"[/i]
[i]Unlock Requirement: Finish a run with 4 copies of the same spell at level 10 or above.[/i]

[b]Starting Spell: Domination[/b]
Carves up nearby demons. Elites that have been hit with Domination are summoned on death, boosting your power. 20% of Choker effects apply to demons summoned this way. Evolves into Apex Predator.

[b]Starting Bonus:[/b] Orb Recovery Effect +20%, Damage Multiplier vs Elites +7%
[i](See Health & Mana Orbs section further in the update)[/i]

[b]Passive 1: Berserk[/b] - You deal 1.5x damage. Max Spell Limit -2.
[b]Passive 2: Madness[/b] - When Elite demons are spawned, spawn an additional one.

[i]The final spellbook Enigma will be coming in the next update, along with a bunch of new spells![/i]

[h2][b]Demon Summoning[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/9f0968d746ddd950d26f351fa8df29294d0b8866.gif[/img]
[i]Summon demons, trapping them inside of a Shrine to massively boost your power![/i]
[olist]
[*][b]Upgrades > Unlock "Corruption"[/b]
[*][b]Win a run with at least 7 Corruption to unlock Demon Summoning![/b]
[i]Reaching 46 Corruption will get you 7 demons at a time. You don't need to maintain a Corruption level to keep the unlocked Demon slots[/i]
[*][b]Find Red Demon Chests to unlock more Demons[/b]
[i]Mainly drops during overtime[/i]
[*][b]Level up demons to increase passive stats and summon duration[/b]
[i]Level up demons using Astral Flowers, or by summoning them if you successfully finish a run.[/i]
[*][b]Find Demonic Equipment[/b]
[i]Equipment such as Demonic Chokers can be equipped into demon slots.[/i]
[*][b]Find Overdrive Chips to limit break demons beyond level 100![/b][/olist]
[i]Drop rates are higher in the main game than they were in Beta.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/c17243f7a65302145689dd3cfaf6ee66f39cba92.gif[/img]
[h2][b]Corruption Difficulty Scaling[/b][/h2]
[olist]
[*]Complete a game with Max Corruption to increase the Corruption limit
[*]Each Corruption grants enemies +1% Damage, +2% Protection, -1% Knockback
[*]Each Corruption level also increases the Score Multiplier by 5%.
[*]Corruption increases the Demon Chest drop rate
[/olist]
[h2][b]Oblivion Modifiers and Charms[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/a54dafa51745a760da5db4a5153698c2ce443415.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Oblivion difficulty options are unlocked after surviving for 20 minutes with 77 Malice
[*] This is a new set of advanced difficulty options that massively increases the available challenge.
[*] Increasing Oblivion allows higher rarity Charms to drop. You can equip 3 Charms.
[*] To get Voidslayer rarity charms, you need to stack Malice and Oblivion.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/eea11e3347ccaece23849bb3ba9475320cff9818.png[/img]

[h2][b]Dashing Enemies[/b][/h2]

Certain enemies will now dash towards you to close the gap. The overall difficulty of enemy projectiles has been toned down to make room for more types of enemy behavior.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/b752435feeed0730f2b9dd0dad1400c9bdde1116.png[/img]

The "Hasted" elite modifier has been renamed to "Drifter", and now also allows the buffed elite demon to dash at you. Demons can shoot you while they're dashing, so make sure you watch out for dangerous combinations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/596714c4bce5c1e5027643f8d7deb3a4258df6cc.png[/img]

[h2][b]Enemy Spawn Notifications[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/c6facaa48cf7267e2b7903b0d89be7f88cf8ad53.png[/img]

Enemies can now also spawn directly onto the map, instead of only from offscreen. A quick warning will show you where enemies are going to appear.

Increasing your [b]Light Radius[/b] will make demons spawn further away from you.

[h2][b]Health & Mana Orb Drops[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/727c3bed69723e9ed7aaf24e35cd0bbb238e0f67.png[/img]

Stronger enemies now drop orbs that refill your Health and Mana! This recovery is instant and is not considered Regeneration.

[h2][b]Spellbook Passive Buffs[/b][/h2]

Most spellbooks have been buffed in ways that allow them to scale further into endgame, or reach it more reliably.

[h3]Tammy[/h3]
ːsteamthisː [b]Passive 1:[/b] Adds a +7% Critical Multiplier bonus onto every Shrine, which improves with Buff Effect. Particularly good with String of Ears!
ːsteamthisː [b]Passive 2:[/b] Now also adds a 13% chance to get 3 upgrades from treasure chests. There is also a summonable demon that allows you to spawn treasure chests, working nicely with this effect.

[h3]Speare[/h3]
ːsteamthisː Speare is stronger than you'd think on first glance, but is missing a bit of juice and early game. Her starter bonus has been upgraded to also have Spell Projectile Amount +1.

[h3]Wolfe[/h3]
ːsteamthisː [b]Passive 2:[/b] Now also reduces Aura Evolution level requirement by 25%.

[h3]Jeane[/h3]
ːsteamthisː [b]Passive 1:[/b] Now grants a 7% HP bonus per revive instead of flat +7 HP.
ːsteamthisː [b]Passive 2:[/b] Now also adds a 50% chance to duplicate buffs stolen from Elites.

[h3]Astrid[/h3]
ːsteamthisː [b]Passive 1:[/b] This passive gives +3% damage for each Astral Flower gained. This has been indirectly buffed because you gain Astral Flowers at a much faster pace in this update.

[h3]Berry[/h3]
ːsteamthisː [b]Passive 1:[/b] Chance to remain at the same level on levelup increased from 10% to 13%.
ːsteamthisː [b]Passive 2:[/b] Buff effect per collected treasure chest increased from 2% to 3%. It is also now possible to spawn more treasure chests than before due to Demon Summoning.

[h3]Sly[/h3]
ːsteamthisː [b]Passive 1:[/b] Now also converts 50% of Movement Speed into Critical Chance.

[h3]Eden[/h3]
ːsteamthisː [b]Starter Spell:[/b] Fixed a bug where Shadow Mine and Reaper Mine were not being affected by any damage bonuses.


[h2][b]Level 10 Spell Effects[/b][/h2]

Spells now grant additional global bonuses at level 10, giving you more ways to scale your build.

4% Of energy shield added as base damage. (All Spells)

Freeze Duration +20% (All Spells)

[h2][b]The Compendium[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/292716af16f093d4c7769f5b058add8eb7efe528.png[/img]

You can now view spell info in the compendium! Accessible from the title screen, level select screen, or during a run. Spells now also display their full descriptions on the Pause Screen.

[h2][b]Buffed & New Illegal Upgrades[/b][/h2]

New Illegal Upgrades have been added, and some existing ones buffed.

[h3]New: Backdraft[/h3]
+35% Chance of enemy projectiles backfiring.
-13% Critical Chance.

[h3]New: Bursting Flesh[/h3]
Max HP +77.
+35% of damage taken bypasses Energy Shield.

All Spells gain +1 Level, Experience Gain +13%.
New: Also grants [b]Health Reservation -13%[/b]. This is a NEGATIVE health reservation value: It can undo existing reservation or increase your recovery limit beyond 100%, letting you overfill your HP.

New: When you lose HP, the amount is reduced by % equal to your Reserved HP, to a max of -75%.

New: Damage Reduction +13%

New: Regeneration Multiplier -40%.

notes.title: Beta UPDATE！Summon Demons, Collect Memory Fragments, and Take Oblivion Challenge
notes.content:
[h3]Hi! I've been working on getting everything ready for the beta as fast as possible. After being tested, this content (and more) will move to the main branch!

To join the Beta in Steam, right-click the game in the library page and select "Properties". Among the available tabs will be the "BETAS" tab.
The beta should be listed in the dropdown menu under "Select the beta you would like to opt into"![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/4fe932009a07f7b6178ba136636619f50de503d2.png[/img]

[h2][b]Corruption, Demons, and Oblivion — New Mechanics and Lore![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/03ff6ae0592bc0733ccee82a6abbaca2abe3beca.png[/img]

🆕[b]New Corruption difficulty system:[/b] An endlessly scaling difficulty climb that allows you to uncover [i]Memory Fragments[/i], and learn the art of [i]Demon Summoning[/i].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/4af4847adf20ff536cf12259ca17f1584b862c62.png[/img]

🆕[b]Memory Fragments Part 1:[/b] Learn more about the world, characters, and lore of Spellbook Demonslayers! The first portion of this system is available for Beta.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/f1d27912f1b73860507c000eb2c2f023f9fe25cc.png[/img]

🆕[b]Demon Summoning:[/b] Equip a selection of demons to grant you passive bonuses during battle. Demons can also be Summoned into Stasis, temporarily suspending them inside a Shrine to grant you an extreme burst of power based on the chosen demon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/9b208ab127653e508637dbc0698ce799cba00960.png[/img]

[i]Demons level up when summoned into Stasis, but only if you win! You can also boost their level by spending Astral Flowers, to a max of Level 100.
By clearing increasing amounts of Corruption, you will earn the ability to equip up to 7 Demons at a time![/i]


🆕[b]New Treasure:[/b] Find treasure chests that contain [i]Demon Essence[/i] to unlock new summons! These are mostly found during overtime.

🆕[b]Demon Limit Break:[/b] When all demons have been unlocked, increase their level caps beyond 100 by finding additional [i]Demon Essences[/i].

🆕[b]Demonic Equipment:[/b] In addition to essences, you can also find [i]Demonic Chokers[/i]! These powerful pieces of equipment will grant additional effects to Stasis for ALL of your demons. Combine demons and equipment to create game-breaking summon combos!

🆕[b]New Oblivion difficulty modifiers:[/b] Trade away the memories of your own power in exchange for the ability to find powerful new equipment called [i]Charms[/i]. (Charms will be coming later in beta, but the Oblivion mods are available right away!)

🆕[b]New Music:[/b] Some new music is being worked on by Val, you can hear early pre-mix versions of them in the beta!

Valeriy Baryshev - Charming (Charms) (UNFINISHED)
Valeriy Baryshev - Coral Sunset (Victory) (UNFINISHED)
Valeriy Baryshev - Crimson Dawn (Difficult Victory) (UNFINISHED)
Valeriy Baryshev - Trailblazer (Upgrades)

Accompanying artists:
Scott Arc - PRANA
TeknoAXE - Walking it Back

🆕[b]New Score Formula:[/b] Increase your score to ridiculous amounts with Oblivion and Corruption!

Previously, playing on 77 Malice would result in the highest possible score multiplier of about 1.4x. In the new system, playing on 77 Malice will result in a multiplier of 2.0x.

Adding 25 Oblivion onto that will result in a [b]27.0x[/b] multiplier.
Stacking Corruption onto that will scale it even further, by 5% per Corruption.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/9f8ede20fca1d23c9c20c6f972f2825d67694970.png[/img]

- Enemy wave balance has been significantly changed.
- A variety of interfaces have been improved visually and functionally.
- Enemy blood can now be disabled.
- A sound now plays whenever you refill Mana.
- The sound that plays when you take damage is now much louder.
- Negative Armor amounts on enemies now is calculated at the same step as Base Damage, allowing it to interact with your damage boosts.
- Time Compression can no longer generate more than 1 Corrupted Shrine. This effect was created before you could level spells beyond 10, and was became overpowered when uncapped spells were added.
- Spell Damage Multiplier per level on uncapped spells reduced from 10% to 9% to bring few-spell and many-spell builds closer in power.
- Various bugfixes

[h2][b]Planned later in Beta[/b][/h2]
🆕[b]New Charms system[/b] will arrive to the game in 7-10 days.
Equip [i]Charms [/i]to boost yourself with powerful effects. Playing with more [i]Oblivion [/i]modifiers increases the power level of [i]Charms [/i]that you can find, and allows you to unlock more [i]Charm [/i]slots.

notes.title: UPCOMING: Dash ability, full rebalance, shrines that shoot!
notes.content:
I'm working on a big update that will have a beta running for soon! The game is also 20% off so if these plans sound good, then now is the perfect time to pick up a copy and start unlocking upgrades to get a head start for the new update.

This is a bit of a longer post so you might want some music. Go put on the album [b]Galerie[/b] by [i]Anomalie[/i]!

[h1]Dash Ability[/h1]

Actively evade enemies, quickly travel to gather dropped EXP, and enable new synergies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/d4371329bda6bf7f2acfbea0530e9f8a1f6d0dbc.png[/img]

The [b]Phase Dash[/b] skill will be available initially, and later updates will add a method of accessing a variety of new Dash Skills. For example, you will unlock a damaging charged rush similar to the shield in [i]Hades[/i], and a dash that sacrifices HP to infuse you with a powerful buff called [b]Fury[/b]!

[h1]Corrupted Shrines[/h1]
These shrines will attack you in various ways, such as firing various patterns of projectiles. Cleanse the shrine by killing demons or breaking its projectiles with dodging / tanking in order to claim [b]Arcane Auras & Upgrades[/b]!

[h1]Arcane Auras & Upgrades[/h1]
Certain stats that some builds rely on to function properly (like Chain) have been separated out into a new upgrade pool, and increased in power. A variety of new Auras and other unique upgrades are also available in this pool.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/64e86685c92e24b0dfa0fb643c87a64f4df54b5c.png[/img]

These upgrades are a noticeable power spike, and they allow you to get the stats you need to cover your build's current weakness without being diluted by standard level up rewards. If you are lacking single target damage, you can take boosts like [b]+50% Elite Damage Multiplier[/b]. If you are lacking pack clear you can take effects like [b]+1 Projectile Chain[/b] or [b]+20% Chance for demons to Explode on death, dealing 13% of their Max HP as damage[/b]. 

This prevents you from being forced into aggressively rerolling early in the run just to get the basic stats & damage to make your build work. It also helps signal the power level of certain effects more effectively, and gives you more distinct decision points each run that you can point to as something that you would like to change on future runs in order to try and get a better outcome.

It also reduces the size of the regular level up pool, making it easier to reroll.

[h1]Full Game Rebalance[/h1]
The entire game is being rebalanced with these new features being taken into consideration. The goal of this is to allow as many builds as possible to be viable at all levels of Malice, and to use the [b]Arcane Aura[/b] system to make sure you have access to the stats their build needs to properly get rolling.

Part of this rebalance will also include a noticeable decrease in the amount of Shrines active at once on most builds: Instead of relying so heavily on temporary power you will gain more permanent power through [b]Arcane Auras[/b]. You are still able to stack huge amounts of buffs by intentionally trying to do so, but builds that aren't specifically focusing on shrines will no longer stop functioning if their buffs expire.

This change causes pretty huge - but warranted - implicit nerf to Shrine Maiden during the endgame. This aura was mandatory for surviving in long runs, which worsened the problem of builds not working if buffs started running out or you missed a few Shrines.

[b]Lethality's[/b] evolution is also going to be replaced. The new evolution will still be turned towards S-Tier power, but this method of accessing and scaling Execution chance is unhealthy for build variety, and Execution is more appropriate as an Arcane Upgrade that all types of builds can access.

[h1]Smuggler Shop Refresh[/h1]
All of the worst and most boring smuggler upgrades are being reworked and replaced with a larger number of unique effects and special synergy options.

A lot of Quality of Life improvements, bugfixes, buffs, and other things will also be in the patch. If there are any QoL improvements you'd like to see or weak spells you think need to be buffed, make sure to post them here!

Overlevel +1, Light Radius +13%. Max HP Reserved: +9%.

notes.title: New SPELLBOOK & SPELLS, 5th SPELL SLOT, and MORE!
notes.content:
[h1]New Features[/h1]

[b]5th Spell Slot[/b]
- You can now customize each run even further by equipping 5 spells at a time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/8d17e3526a9b9e80bc612c1f6896d3750cb810e7.png[/img]

[b]Game Rebalance[/b]
- The 2nd map has been rebalanced for a smoother progression of difficulty and currency. Previously the maps were roughly the same difficulty, but now they progress into each other instead.

[b]NOTE:[/b] The way the speed system is handled has resulted in a change to the numbers on the speed bar on the Stage Select screen. The available speed range is now 70% - 150% of the current base speed, which is a range equivalent to 100% - 225% on the old version. Only max out this bar if you want enemies to be [b]VERY[/b] fast.

[i]You may want to adjust your Malice settings depending on your map.[/i]


[b]New Spellbook: Eden[/b]

[b]Eden's Starting Stats[/b]
When you kill a demon, regenerate 0.13 HP over 0.7 seconds.
Knockback +13%.

[b]Passive 1: Overflow[/b]
- Your Regeneration is doubled.

[b]Passive 2: Mercy[/b]
- Damage taken is capped at 25% of Max HP.

[b]Eden's Starter Spell: Shadow Mine[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/b7a8305ab7b7062d947a24f4d7b84409dba1efb5.png[/img]

- Lay a mine at your feet. When triggered by a demon, impale them with a shadowy lance that releases bursts of energy based on projectile amount.

[b]Evolution: Reaper Mine[/b]
- Evolved Shadow Mine. Burst size increases with each repeat. When an Elite demon dies, regenerate 50% of your Max HP over 7 seconds.



[b]New Spell: Blade Whorl[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/d9806279181ae415de672f71940f7ca0a923034c.png[/img]

- Throw an aimed volley of spinning blades. The blades return to where they were thrown from, piercing all demons.

[b]Evolution: Hunter Vortex[/b]
- Evolved Blade Whorl. Summons spinning blades that rotate around yourself and Elite demons, cutting down everything in their path


[h1]Evolution Changes[/h1]

[b]Nova Cleave[/b]
- Slash portion now also reduces enemy Armor by -1 (stacks).

[b]Cataclysm Sigil[/b]
- Now also triggers additional nearby explosions while attached to an Elite.

[b]Indra's Sigil[/b]
- Now also gains Secondary Projectile Amount +1 for every 100% Critical Chance you have.


[h1]Improvements & Changes[/h1]

- Optimized the physics of projectiles and damaging areas.

- The Smuggler's reward and reroll algorithms have been improved to make it easier to find what you need.

- Damaging Areas are now capable of Freezing demons, except for Burning Ground.

- Base EXP Pickup radius has been increased, but you no longer have infinite pickup range during overtime. All gems are still picked up when you enter overtime, and you will still have access to Experience Shrines & Wealthy Elites to manage excess gems.

- The potency of each Malice modifier has been reduced by a very small amount to balance out with the higher difficulty of the 2nd map.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

- Fixed an issue where some percentage-based healing effects were not taking your full Max HP into account.

- Fixed an issue where some enemies had incorrect knockback resistance.

- Fixed an error where the "Adaptation" evolution of "Thickening" Aura was missing the text for gaining Armor when not at full HP. (The effect itself was working, the text was just not appearing).

- Fixed a variety of other minor bugs.

notes.title: Optimizations & Bugfixes
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where Smoke Barrage would not appear in the Smuggler's Shop.

- Fixed an issue where progression costs would sometimes begin to scale much higher than intended.

- Fixed an issue where existing elite enemies would gain extra Damage Reduction if they were alive when Endless mode loops. This damage reduction was only meant to apply to the elites that spawn in the new loop.

- Optimized the amount of calculations needed to determine how much damage an enemy will take when hit.

- Optimized the amount of calculations needed to determine how much damage a projectile or damaging area will deal.

- Optimized the amount of calculations needed to determine whether an enemy with knockback resistance will be knocked back.

- Fixed an issue where Inferno's knockback was lower than intended.

- Fixed an issue where lightning bolts from some sources had 0 Knockback.

- Fixed an issue where some skills would report incorrect damage values.

- Fixed an issue with text spacing when using an Asian language.

- Your equipped passive is now shown at the end of the run stats screen.

- Reduced the rate of HP scaling on elite enemies during overtime.

notes.title: NEW ILLEGAL SPELLS and QoL Improvements!
notes.content:
[h1]New Illegal Spells:[/h1]

- Phantom Reap
Throw 4 scythes in a cross shape that return to their starting location, piercing all demons. When this hits a demon, regenerate 0.13 HP over 1.3 seconds.

- Venom Cleave
Fire a burst of noxious fumes at nearby enemies, followed by a toxic slash that deals 4x base damage. Enemies killed by the slash leave toxic Burning Ground on death that permanently inflicts them with -1% HP per second.

- Smoke Barrage
Chokes enemies with damaging smoke. Extra projectiles also add repeat casts. Increases Dodge chance & move speed by +13% for 3 seconds when cast.

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

- Enemy amount & speed has been increased in the early game. This is only intended to make the early game more exciting, [b]NOT[/b] to make the game feel way harder, so please let me know if it feels too difficult.

- A new end of run stats screen has been added. This screen can be expanded on in the future to be more detailed.

- You can now view damage dealt by spells in the pause menu.

- You can now view Banished upgrades in the pause menu.

- Eyepopper now shoots faster and has longer range.

- Hailstorm, Freezing Rain, and Toxic Blizzard now have much larger projectiles.

- Trail Blazer's burning ground now lasts twice as long in order to offset a previous change which made burning ground have higher damage but less duration.

- Unlocks that require an achievement now show their unlock requirement in their info box, instead of needing to navigate to the Achievements interface.

- Mouse cursor will now be hidden while using a controller.

- Your chosen passive will now be displayed in the pause screen.

- The following stats have been added to the stat display:

Max Level
Dodge Chance
Damage Reduction
Flowers Gained
Triple Damage Chance

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

- Fixed a bug where duplicate entries would sometimes appear in the Auras & Effects screen.

- Fixed a memory leak related to information about level-up choices from previous runs.

- Fixed a bug where Berry's passive effect was not removed after finishing a run.

- Fixed a bug where the Bloodspark shrine would sometimes fire 1 projectile instead of 6.

- Fixed an issue with the positioning of Cataclysm Sigil that would cause it to miss against some enemies.

- Fixed an issue where Energy Cleave and Nova Cleave were dealing 400% damage instead of 500%.

- Increased the maximum number of elites that can be active at once from 9 to 12.

notes.title: Less Bugs, More Damage
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where the Russian language option would sometimes not appear. (Improvements to Russian translation and language layout coming soon!)

- Fixed a bug where enemy damage bonuses would not reset after the elite that provided the buff was defeated, causing their damage to sometimes scale to ridiculous amounts.

- Fixed a bug related to shrine effects expiring that could cause the player's damage to be reduced.

- Fixed a bug with the physics that could cause projectiles to miss enemies

- [b]Shrine Kill Requirement[/b] Malice modifier can now be enabled, bringing the total Malice available to 70.

- [b]Galaxy Brain [/b]Triple Damage Chance increased from 10% + 1% per aura level to 10% + 2% per aura level

- [b]Reverberation [/b]now also gains -2% cooldown reduction for each level of the aura when evolved.

- [b]Enemy Frequency [/b]Malice modifier is now free. The Malice list has been rearranged to make more sense, with the most difficult options at the bottom.

- All Unbound Auras that previously cost 4 have been reduced to cost 2.
- All Unbound Auras that previously cost 7 have been reduced to cost 4.
- Some unbound Auras that previously cost 9 have been reduced to cost 7.

- Fixed a bug where the character "Eden" would show as being unlocked when she is not yet available in early access.

- Fixed a bug where the additional Triple Damage Chance from leveling Brainpower was not being taken into consideration for the Critical Chance bonus from Full Force (Evolution effect of Intensity Aura)

- Added support for analog stick in menus

[b]Keep an eye out for an update tomorrow that will add 3 new Illegal Spells, and some new Illegal Upgrades! New spellbooks and spells also coming later this week![/b]

notes.title: Hotfixes & Tweaks!
notes.content:
- Fixed some missing translations and typos.
- Reduced requirement to unlock Sly from 4 gambles in a run to 3.
- Fixed a bug where some upgrades cost a different amount than what they said.
- Fixed a bug where the new spellbooks had the same image as Speare when using the Play as Spellbook option.
- Fixed a bug where the Deathbound aura had incorrect evolution info.
- Increased the speed of Cataclysm Sigil by 15%
- Increased the speed of Indra's Sigil by 15%
- Reduced the amount of knockback resistance gained by demons during Timed Challenge and the first loop of Endless

I'm aware of a couple other bugs that have been reported which I'm working on fixing now. Thanks for all of your feedback and suggestions, it's extremely helpful!

The best place to leave feedback is in a Steam Review where I can check on everything in 1 place.

[h3]Did you know that living Spellbooks are actually mages who turned into books so their powers could be used by our heroine?[/h3]
